listing.title: Aaroh Real Daisy Black Resin Oxidised Drop Earrings
listing.description: Statement drop earrings featuring real dried white daisy flowers set in glossy black resin, framed with oxidised silver-tone detailing and finished with black bead and pearl-style tassels. The lightweight pair works with ethnic, Indo-western, western and bohemian outfits for parties, festivals, weddings or casual outings.
listing.careInstructions: Keep away from water, perfume and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry jewellery box or pouch when not in use.
listing.returnConditions: Returns or exchanges are accepted within 10 days of delivery under the standard Hastabazaar return policy.

verifiedFacts.colour: Black, white, yellow and oxidised silver tone

sourceConcerns: The source-listed 7.5 x 5 x 7 cm dimensions appear package-level and were not used as product dimensions.
The real-flower claim was not independently tested.
